Strategy: Shift the gentle fifteen sweet band upward to residuals between thirty-five and fifty while keeping the mid penalty at fifteen. This tests whether slightly roomier leftovers work better with gentle steering, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 35 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
